scope.processing: one target at a time, one process, BLAS/OpenMP thread caps set before numerical work
scope.reporting_rule: selected conventional score pooled 80th percentile within target; ties retained; association only, not a detection estimate
scope.richness_eligibility: all presences plus class-specific backgrounds; minimum 20 presences and 20 backgrounds in every fold; equal fold mean; common_all_strata requires all three classes
scope.richness_name: other-species richness = retained effort_richness - focal y; these are richness strata, not measured effort
